name: University of the Cumberlands
tuition_note: Private school with single 'One Price Promise' rate for all students (KY resident, non-resident, military, international all $9,875/yr full-time tuition & fees). Room & board $9,300 (combined; no room-only figure published). Source: ucumberlands.edu/tuition, rates effective Summer 2023 Term onward (no explicit academic-year label on page).
